dropzones.name: Aviosuperficie Torraccia
dropzones.status_evidence: Historical international directories list a tandem/AFF dropzone at Torraccia, but no 2025+ operation was found; the national Olympic committee’s 2012 report describes most parachuting abroad and only an annual demonstration locally. Re-checked 2026-11-14: The national Olympic committee’s 2012 report says parachuting was performed abroad apart from the annual 6 January Torraccia demonstration. No dated 2025+ regular civilian jump operation was found in Italian searches.

sources.what: Historical dropzone listing incorrectly grouped under Italy
Explicit Torraccia location and historical aircraft-based school offering
National Olympic committee historical account of local demonstration versus overseas activity

dropzones.note: Historical directory claim retained as uncertain, not a confirmed operating school; regular local operation needs verification. San Marino is a separate country from Italy.
